# Narayana Study Hall

> A 24/7 study hall and reading room in Sangareddy, Telangana, India, for competitive exam preparation. 105 seats: 75 AC and 30 non-AC. Free Wi-Fi, drinking water, washrooms and ground-floor parking. Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, since November 2023.

- Address: Mig 7, 5-43, Sangareddy Bypass Rd, beside Bashweshwara statue, APHB Colony, Pothreddipalle, Sangareddy, Telangana 502001
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99481 31602, +91 93471 57236
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/nAkwznu7WkpQzKkZ9
- Website: https://narayanastudyhall.com/
